title: Video Editing Services in Charleston, SC
metaTitle: Video Editing Services in Charleston, SC | TDM
metaDescription: Video editing for Charleston businesses: reels, ad cuts, property and venue films, wedding vendor promos and recruitment video, edited remotely by TDM.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) edits video for Charleston businesses: reels, ad cuts, brand films, product videos and long recordings turned into short clips. You send the footage and a brief, and our editors return finished files in the shapes each platform needs. Editing is done at TDM's operations office in Lahore, so there is no edit suite to visit in Charleston, and none is needed. Where the footage does not exist yet, our US-based team can film it.

sections.heading: A city full of footage that nobody has cut
paragraphs: Charleston businesses rarely lack material. A wedding venue has clips from dozens of ceremonies under the oaks. A rooftop bar has phone video of every sunset over the harbor. A charter captain has hours from the bow. A builder in Mount Pleasant has drone passes over every finished house. What they lack is the time to sort it, cut it, caption it and post it before the season has moved on.

The same is true away from the visitor trade. A logistics firm near the port has walk-through footage of its warehouse. A clinic has recorded talks from its doctors. An employer hiring for the plants in North Charleston and Ridgeville has interviews with staff sitting on a hard drive. Each of these can be shaped into recruitment clips, sales material or ads without filming a single new frame.

sections.heading: What the editing covers
paragraphs: We start from where the video will run and what it has to do there, then build the story, pacing and opening seconds around that.
bullets: Short vertical edits for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, with captions burned in for viewers watching on mute.
Ad cuts in several lengths, each with alternative openings so campaigns can test which one holds attention.
Brand, venue and property films with color grading, sound cleanup and licensed music.
Long recordings such as talks, tours and interviews broken into a series of clips.
Titles, lower thirds and simple motion graphics in your brand style.
Every deliverable exported in 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9 as required.

sections.heading: Editing around the Charleston calendar
paragraphs: Timing shapes what is worth cutting. Couples choose venues and vendors many months before the date, so wedding businesses need their best spring and autumn footage edited and published while next year's couples are researching. Hotels and tour operators need trip-planning content out before the busy weeks, not during them.
We suggest sending footage in batches and agreeing a rhythm, so there is always a bank of finished edits ready.

sections.heading: How to send footage and what to check
paragraphs: Upload original files, not clips already compressed by a messaging app. Tell us who appears on camera and whether they have agreed to be shown, which matters for wedding guests, patients and employees. Say whether music in the raw footage is licensed, because a song playing at a reception cannot be used in an ad. Feedback is given as timestamped notes, and revisions are handled centrally by the same editors.

presence: A member of our team is based in South Carolina, though not in Charleston, and can discuss your footage and goals with you. The editing itself is done by TDM's editors at our operations office in Lahore, with files exchanged online and feedback handled through timestamped comments.

faqs.q: Do you have video editors in Charleston?
faqs.a: No. Our editors work at TDM's operations office in Lahore and serve Charleston clients remotely. A member of our team is based in South Carolina, and footage and finished files are shared online.

faqs.q: Can you edit footage we shot ourselves on a phone?
faqs.a: Yes. Much of the footage Charleston businesses send is phone video. We stabilise, grade, clean the sound and cut it for the platform.

faqs.q: Can you edit wedding footage into ads for my venue?
faqs.a: Yes, provided you have the right to use it. Check your agreement with the videographer and the couple, and replace any commercial music. We then cut versions for your website, social channels and paid ads.

faqs.q: What does video editing cost for a Charleston business?
faqs.a: It depends on the amount of footage, the number of finished videos and the level of graphics and grading. We quote after a free consultation and a look at your material.

faqs.q: How quickly will we get the edits back?
faqs.a: That depends on the brief and the volume of footage. Delivery dates and revision rounds are agreed in the plan before editing starts, and regular batches can be scheduled around your season.
